answer: An agent economy funding a weather station on a knoll gives each agent voting weight equal to the tokens it locks in a vault for 30 days. Splitting 100 tokens across a thousand identities still yields only 100 votes, so fake accounts add no influence. To gain a delta of 100 votes, an attacker must acquire and lock 100 more tokens, tying up capital and bearing the risk that its price falls during the lock.
